data.title: 三司绫濑 · 访谈前的提纲
data.description: 活动开始前，绫濑最后看了一遍提纲。工作人员在门外招呼她时，她把纸放好，换上熟悉的笑容。
data.action: holding interview notes beside a table
data.promptProse: Inside an elegant VIP event waiting lounge, Ayase holds a typed interview outline against her chest, turning toward the open doorway with an impeccable, practiced idol smile. The room features tasteful modern wall sconces, a low glass coffee table with bottled water, and a blurred corridor visible beyond the doorway, capturing the poised professional moment before stepping on stage.
